content:
Alice M: kicking off RC 2026-rc-17 for seq-svc. artifacts: gcr.io/redwood/seq-svc:rc-17. targeting change window 2026-04-02 15:00-16:00 UTC. requesting greenlight + pin of runtime and model versions.
DeployBot: RC created: 2026-rc-17 | artifacts verified | checks: build,unit,container-scan ✅ | pin labels: runtime=3.1.4, model=1.4.2 | tracker: https://deploy.redwood/rc/2026-rc-17
Ben K: staging smoke ran at 14:05 — 200 requests p95=78ms (baseline 76ms), errors 0.02%. no obvious mem spikes.
Clara S: QA summary: regression-suite v2.9 mostly clean. minor flake in embeddings e2e, repro steps collected. blocking? low severity.
Alice M: plan: start canary at 5% for 15m, then step to 25% for 20m if SLOs hold. rollback on >1% error delta or p95 regression > +50ms.
ops-sheriff: please attach rollback commands and who owns the rollback. I want a clear decision ladder.
Alice M: rollback playbook (short):
```
# manual rollback
1) curl -X POST https://deploy.redwood/api/rollback -d '{"service":"seq-svc","target":"previous"}'
2) remove rc tag from routing: redwood route set seq-svc --weight rc=0
3) notify #incidents + oncall
```
Auto-fallback: if canary hits thresholds, traffic router falls back to model=1.4.1 automatically (configured).
Ben K: confirming metrics queries:
```
alerts: increase(error_rate, 1m) > 1
perf: p95(seq-svc) > baseline + 50
```
Clara S: QA-Bot reran flaky embedding test on canary build and passed 3/3 reruns. I'll keep an eye during canary.
QA-Bot: regression-suite v2.9: all tests passed on rc-17 in staging at 14:12 UTC.
DeployBot: Promo window reserved: 2026-04-02 15:00-16:00 UTC. Canary rollout schedule: 0m@5% -> 15m@5% -> 20m@25% -> 10m@100% (gradual).
Alice M: requesting explicit approvals: runtime owners @Ben K, QA signoff @Clara S, ops OK @ops-sheriff. Also want release notes blurb posted.
Ben K: runtime owner ACK. I'll be in watch during window.
ops-sheriff: ops ACK. deadman switch set: if error rate delta >1% or p95 +50ms sustained for 3 polls -> auto rollback threshold triggers. Contact list in playbook is correct.
Clara S: QA ACK. release notes: "seq-svc: RC-17 — routing performance improvements, model bump to 1.4.2, fixes for embeddings flakiness". I'll paste final notes to releases doc before promo.
Alice M: pin request: please pin runtime=3.1.4 and model=1.4.2 for the RC in the release registry.
DeployBot: Pins applied to release registry: runtime=3.1.4, model=1.4.2. Artifact hashes: sha256:abcd...1234.
Ben K: quick sanity check: have we scheduled the KV warm step? we need KV warm at least 10m before canary.
Alice M: yes — KV warm scheduled at 14:50 UTC via orchestration job.
ops-sheriff: ops checklist complete. I've added a traffic guard rule: block promo if infra CPU > 70% in target region.
Clara S: noted. I'll monitor QA metrics channel and post any regressions.
Alice M: greenlight?
Ben K: +1 :thumbsup: — runtime owner greenlight.
Clara S: +1 — QA greenlight.
ops-sheriff: +1 — ops greenlight.
Alice M: thanks. scheduling final promo runbook at 2026-04-02T14:55Z. Will post post-deploy checklist in here after promo.
DeployBot: Promo job created and queued. Runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood/seq-svc/rc-17
Alice M: locking thread for visibility. if any late concerns ping here ASAP. :lock:
